goal: Build an x86 virtual machine emulator with: CPU (general purpose registers EAX-EDI, segment registers, EFLAGS, EIP), ALU (arithmetic and logic operations with flag updates), instruction decoder (ModR/M, SIB, prefix handling, opcode tables), memory management (4GB address space, paging, segmentation), I/O subsystem (port-mapped I/O, interrupt controller), and execution engine (fetch-decode-execute pipeline). Support real mode and protected mode.
functional_spec:
## Functional Specification

Domain: emulator
Summary: Full x86 virtual machine emulator supporting real and protected mode with complete instruction set, memory management, and I/O subsystem

### Requirements (MUST implement)
- Support real mode (20-bit addressing, segments)
- Support protected mode (32-bit addressing, paging, segmentation)
- Implement all general purpose registers (EAX, EBX, ECX, EDX, ESI, EDI, EBP, ESP)
- Implement segment registers (CS, DS, ES, FS, GS, SS)
- Implement EFLAGS register with all status flags
- Handle all addressing modes (register, immediate, direct, indirect, indexed)
- Support ModR/M byte decoding with all 256 combinations
- Support SIB byte decoding with all 256 combinations
- Handle instruction prefixes (0x66, 0x67, 0xF0, 0xF2, 0xF3, segment overrides)
- Implement port-mapped I/O for 65536 ports
- Handle maskable and non-maskable interrupts
- Support page translation with 4KB pages
- Handle segment descriptors and descriptor tables
- Implement call gates and task switches
- Support all x86 exceptions (divide error, page fault, general protection, etc)

### Data Structures
- 8 32-bit general purpose registers EAX-EDI
- 6 16-bit segment registers CS/DS/ES/FS/GS/SS
- 32-bit EFLAGS register
- 32-bit EIP register
- 4GB byte-addressable memory space
- 65536 I/O ports
- Descriptor tables (GDT, LDT, IDT) with 8-byte entries
- Page directories with 1024 4-byte entries
- Page tables with 1024 4-byte entries
- 8-byte task state segments
- 6-byte segment descriptors

### Components
- **cpu** (complex, ~800 LOC)
  - getRegister(register: number): number - read register value
  - setRegister(register: number, value: number): void - write register
  - getSegment(segment: number): number - read segment selector
  - setSegment(segment: number, selector: number): void - load segment
  - getFlag(flag: number): boolean - read specific flag bit
  - setFlag(flag: number, value: boolean): void - set/clear flag
  - switchToRealMode(): void - transition to real mode
  - switchToProtectedMode(): void - transition to protected mode
  - raiseInterrupt(vector: number): void - deliver interrupt
  - raiseException(vector: number, errorCode: number): void - deliver exception
  - REQ: Maintain register state for 8 general purpose registers
  - REQ: Maintain segment registers with hidden descriptor cache
  - REQ: Handle mode switching between real and protected
  - REQ: Coordinate fetch-decode-execute pipeline
  - REQ: Manage interrupt and exception delivery
- **decoder** (complex, ~600 LOC)
  - decode(cpu: ICpu): IInstruction - decode next instruction
  - decodePrefix(bytes: Uint8Array): IPrefixes - parse prefixes
  - decodeOpcode(bytes: Uint8Array): IOpcode - parse opcode
  - decodeModRm(byte: number): IModRm - parse ModR/M
  - decodeSib(byte: number): ISib - parse SIB
  - calculateDisplacement(modRm: IModRm, sib: ISib): number - get displacement
  - calculateInstructionLength(prefixes: IPrefixes, opcode: IOpcode): number - get length
  - REQ: Decode all x86 instruction opcodes
  - REQ: Parse instruction prefixes in correct order
  - REQ: Decode ModR/M and SIB bytes
  - REQ: Calculate instruction length
  - REQ: Extract immediate operands
- **alu** (complex, ~400 LOC)
  - add(dest: number, src: number, size: number): number - add with carry
  - sub(dest: number, src: number, size: number): number - subtract with borrow
  - mul(value: number, size: number): number - unsigned multiply
  - imul(value: number, size: number): number - signed multiply
  - div(value: number, size: number): number - unsigned divide
  - idiv(value: number, size: number): number - signed divide
  - and(dest: number, src: number, size: number): number - bitwise and
  - or(dest: number, src: number, size: number): number - bitwise or
  - xor(dest: number, src: number, size: number): number - bitwise xor
  - not(value: number, size: number): number - bitwise not
  - REQ: Perform all arithmetic operations (add, sub, mul, div)
  - REQ: Perform all logic operations (and, or, xor, not)
  - REQ: Perform all shift/rotate operations
  - REQ: Update all status flags correctly
  - REQ: Handle overflow and carry correctly
- **memory** (complex, ~500 LOC)
  - read(address: number, size: number): number - read memory
  - write(address: number, value: number, size: number): void - write memory
  - readPhysical(address: number, size: number): number - read physical
  - writePhysical(address: number, value: number, size: number): void - write physical
  - translateAddress(linear: number): number - linear to physical
  - checkSegmentAccess(segment: number, offset: number, write: boolean): void - validate
  - enablePaging(): void - turn on paging
  - disablePaging(): void - turn off paging
  - loadPageDirectory(address: number): void - set page directory
  - REQ: Provide 4GB address space
  - REQ: Implement segmentation checks
  - REQ: Implement page translation
  - REQ: Handle memory protection
  - REQ: Raise page faults on violations
- **io** (moderate, ~200 LOC)
  - readPort(port: number, size: number): number - read from port
  - writePort(port: number, value: number, size: number): void - write to port
  - registerDevice(port: number, device: IDevice): void - register device
  - setPortPermission(port: number, allowed: boolean): void - set permission
  - REQ: Provide 65536 I/O ports
  - REQ: Route port accesses to devices
  - REQ: Handle port permissions
  - REQ: Raise exceptions on violations

### Integration Rules (CRITICAL)
- CPU uses memory.read() and memory.write() - does not access RAM directly
- CPU uses io.readPort() and io.writePort() - does not access ports directly
- Memory uses pageTable.translate() for virtual address translation
- CPU uses decoder.decode() to interpret instruction bytes
- ALU uses cpu.setFlags() to update EFLAGS - does not modify directly
- cpu MUST use injected dependencies via their interfaces. Do NOT duplicate state that other modules own.
- decoder MUST use injected dependencies via their interfaces. Do NOT duplicate state that other modules own.
- alu MUST use injected dependencies via their interfaces. Do NOT duplicate state that other modules own.
- memory MUST use injected dependencies via their interfaces. Do NOT duplicate state that other modules own.
- io MUST use injected dependencies via their interfaces. Do NOT duplicate state that other modules own.
- Each component owns its own state. Other components access it ONLY through the public interface — never copy internal data.
- Use camelCase for all method names. No snake_case.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Can execute real mode COM files
- Can boot protected mode operating systems
- All arithmetic/logic instructions update flags correctly
- Memory protection prevents unauthorized access
- Interrupts are delivered to correct handlers
- Paging translates virtual to physical addresses
- Segmentation applies base/limit checks
- I/O instructions correctly interface with devices
- Exceptions trigger appropriate fault handlers
